title: 2024 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: A data set containing \(20\) numbers, some of which are \(6,\) has mean \(45.\) When all the \(6\)s are removed, the data set has mean \(66.\) How many \(6\)s were in the original data set?

solutions.text: The full set sums to \(20\cdot45=900.\) Removing \(k\) sixes leaves \(20-k\) numbers summing to \(900-6k,\) with mean \(66,\) so \(900-6k=66(20-k)\) \(=1320-66k.\) Then \(60k=420,\) giving \(k=7.\) Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: If there are \(k\) sixes, the remaining \(20-k\) numbers sum to \(900-6k=66(20-k)\)
